identity.kind: IBC tote (intermediate bulk container) for liquid storage/transport

risks.proof: Photo of the bottom valve/fitting area of each tote.

risks.proof: Photo of the capacity/manufacturer plate usually found on the tote's side.

Photo of the manufacturer/capacity plate on the tank.
Photo of the top cap/lid area.
